rows.cases: Remove a disclosed act, declaration or boundary sample in turn; reconstruction must identify the missing cause before solving.
rows.hold: No executable completeness corpus exists until the records and replay bites.
rows.name: public-inputs
rows.oracle: A separately written inventory walk over the full accepted-act sequence and references, without compiler summaries.
rows.property: Reordering unordered input collections preserves the compiled object; removing a cause cannot preserve a complete verdict.

rows.cases: Exercise complete and missing address samples, settlement depth, provenance and conditional operator-bound evidence.
rows.hold: External destruction and settlement assurance remain deployment obligations.
rows.name: burn-boundary
rows.oracle: Manual four-object boundary inventory and independent disclosure checklist against the declared realization.
rows.property: Changing evidence cannot add a fifth mathematical input; required evidence omission prevents publication readiness.

rows.cases: Use a hyper-act, repeated netting acts, a zero fold and a control act; retain all identities and charge each once.
rows.hold: Exact fixtures must be transcribed and reviewed before the compiler is claimed complete.
rows.name: complete-acts
rows.oracle: Direct enumeration of authored identities and rational debit sums, independent of the cell builder.
rows.property: Cell partition covers accepted authored acts exactly once while counts follow members, not cells or legs.

rows.cases: Missing co-leg, dangling recipient, Registration, conflicting sales, co-epoch cancellation and later cancellation cases.
rows.hold: Authentication realization conformance waits for a declared deployment adapter.
rows.name: formation-title
rows.oracle: Small exhaustive settlement candidate enumeration with a boundary-by-boundary title table.
rows.property: Valid dependency permutations preserve title; sentiment perturbation cannot change a recognized transfer.

rows.cases: Charge two successive declared prices, then change the current price; prior debits must remain unchanged.
rows.hold: Non-rational charged-value support is held until its equality and certification contract is reviewed.
rows.name: ledger-vintages
rows.oracle: Independent exact rational ledger for representable profiles, plus reviewed expression witnesses for any added profile.
rows.property: Debit totals, emission and capacity read the same charged value and epoch; full/reduced unit conversion commutes.

rows.cases: Unequal domain profiles, Invitation A-leg versus T-leg, repeated fold cells, home-resolved acts and revocation ties.
rows.hold: Released corrections require new expected values; legacy staged expectations are not substitutes.
rows.name: final-state
rows.oracle: Small direct cell and recipient tables written independently of production aggregation.
rows.property: Dependency-compliant permutations preserve the compiled base, emission and hull when all stated inputs are fixed.

rows.cases: A depleted relay, zero-emission source, closed cluster and retained diagonal with nonzero incoming mass.
rows.hold: Transcendental cases require the reviewed numerical backend and certified oracle.
rows.name: conservation
rows.oracle: Dense rational matrix products at zero tilt, independently compared with sparse factor application.
rows.property: Row sums and transported balance/count totals are conserved; exported count obeys the emission bound.

rows.cases: Equal-width graphs of different shape, a zero-width case and fences below, at and above the margin boundary.
rows.hold: Backend soundness and adversarial executions remain held until the numerical bite.
rows.name: certificate
rows.oracle: Independent high-precision directed evaluation plus exact zero-tilt and rational analytic cases; shared kernel output alone is insufficient.
rows.property: Equal width at fixed wall/profile/rung yields equal fence; residual enclosure contains the independently certified equilibrium.

rows.cases: An indecisive high rung, a proved failed rung and a lower pass under one published finite refinement policy.
rows.hold: Canonical rung agreement waits for the deployment procedure and its execution vectors.
rows.name: rung-verdicts
rows.oracle: A linear reference scan evaluating each rung independently from disclosed factors.
rows.property: Replay selects the greatest procedure-proved pass and preserves each higher attempted verdict and budget.

rows.cases: Overlapping principal closures sharing a parent, interleaved blocks, missing parent, target/minimum and maximum-duration closures.
rows.hold: Earliest host determination is attested boundary evidence; replay cannot reconstruct unwritten demand.
rows.name: final-membership
rows.oracle: Exhaustive closure-set intersection and component enumeration on small proposed histories.
rows.property: Component partition is disjoint, covers the union and is invariant to processing order; authoritative positions remain checked.

rows.cases: Individual failure hidden by a positive average, exact equality, threshold straddling, empty epoch and target overflow.
rows.hold: Final numerical threshold evidence waits for the supported profile; missing evidence is never counted as passing.
rows.name: admission
rows.oracle: Hand-derived rational W1/W2 cases with explicit numeraire, counts, prices and reduced stamps.
rows.property: Only a fully certified final state can accept; no member of a rejected or indecisive proposed set takes effect.

rows.cases: Zero width, empty live domain, trigger/cap/escalation order, stale next-width bound and downward migration.
rows.hold: Deployment must supply a total procedure and certified results; no paper-maintainer calibration hold remains.
rows.name: policy-schedules
rows.oracle: Independent boundary-sequence model evaluating the declared procedure and explicit invariant predicates.
rows.property: Lead, positive charge, step and hysteresis constraints and X1–X7 hold for the published charge, including exceptional cases.

rows.cases: Round-trip the complete package; reject duplicate keys, noncanonical bytes, missing sections and incomplete references.
rows.hold: Namespace assignment, complete CDDL theory and CBOR dependency proposal require review before the publication bite.
rows.name: publication
rows.oracle: Independently authored byte vectors and a section-by-section semantic inventory.
rows.property: Equivalent normalized structures encode identically; optional diagnostic data cannot change binding fields.

rows.cases: Mutate each package section, omit an act and alter a charged vintage, rung verdict or rounding disclosure.
rows.hold: Cross-implementation agreement is held until an independent implementation runs the declared profile.
rows.name: replay
rows.oracle: A public-input verifier and independently implemented small-case mathematics, not a host-cache comparison.
rows.property: Every mismatch is attributed to a section and claim; valid envelope acceptance cannot stand for mathematical verification.

rows.cases: Locked override, late announcement, exact literal mismatch and computed constant with an uncertified decimal.
rows.hold: Dependency versions and numerical constant witnesses require review before use.
rows.name: constants
rows.oracle: Read-only correspondence against defining declarations and independently enclosed computed values.
rows.property: Effective-boundary lookup preserves historical values; locked constants cannot change through generic override carriers.

rows.cases: Change raw caches, terminal preferences and optional diagnostics while fixing the binding inputs.
rows.hold: Terminal engines, operational availability and external assurances remain outside the implemented surface.
rows.name: terminal-separation
rows.oracle: Dependency/read-site audit and differential package runs with all optional data varied.
rows.property: Binding fields and admission remain unchanged; required evidence stays mandatory even when no formula reads it.

rows.cases: A negative cycle, parallel projections, tied products, zero determinant and a route revisiting the source.
rows.hold: Unresolved scalar comparisons return INDECISIVE; resource exhaustion never returns an exact-service result.
rows.name: raw-readings
rows.oracle: Exhaustive independent simple-path enumeration on tiny graphs with exact products and separate parity calculation.
rows.property: All and only bounded simple paths contribute to parity maxima; raw Self is derived, never appended as an act.
